name: Census Gazetteer Files (places)
used_for: Place coordinates (internal point) and land area.

name: Population Estimates, sub-county (cities and towns)
publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program
attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, Vintage 2024 Population Estimates
used_for: Latest population, legal type, county of each place.

name: American Community Survey 5-year estimates
attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates
used_for: Home value, rent, income, vacancy, housing age, broadband, poverty, commute, enrollment.

name: Building Permits Survey, place-level annual (Northeast region)
attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, Building Permits Survey
used_for: Housing units permitted per year (3-year rolling mean per 1,000 residents).

name: National Register of Historic Places, spatial data
attribution: National Park Service, National Register of Historic Places
used_for: Whether a listed historic district lies within the place.

name: TIGERweb incorporated place boundaries
used_for: Place polygons for spatial joins (historic districts, OSM business counts).

name: Rail stations (Amtrak and Metro-North)
publisher: U.S. DOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics; MTA
licence: Public domain (BTS NTAD); MTA developer data terms (GTFS)
attribution: BTS National Transportation Atlas Database; MTA Metro-North Railroad GTFS
used_for: Straight-line miles from each place to the nearest passenger rail station.

name: Zillow Home Value Index (ZHVI) and Observed Rent Index (ZORI), city level
licence: Free to use with attribution (Zillow Research data terms)
used_for: Current home value and rent where Zillow covers the place; gaps stay gaps.

name: NYS Health Facility General Information
publisher: New York State Department of Health (Health Data NY)
licence: Open data (NYS Open Data terms of use)
attribution: New York State Department of Health, Health Facility General Information
used_for: Hospital locations for drive time to the nearest hospital.

name: OSRM routing (public demo server)
licence: ODbL (OpenStreetMap data); demo server usage policy, one request per second
attribution: Routing by OSRM using OpenStreetMap data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors
used_for: Drive minutes to New York City, the nearest regional hub, and the nearest hospital.

name: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API
used_for: Count of storefront businesses and services inside the place boundary.

name: Downtown Revitalization Initiative and NY Forward awards
attribution: New York State Department of State, DRI and NY Forward program pages
used_for: Which places won a state downtown award, in which round and year.
